items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: There was Sven Asmussen, a trombone player named Leo Matissen

ctx.x: And during my stay I made a concert just before the Germans took Denmark at a place called Karpehollen.
There was Sven Asmussen, a trombone player named Leo Matissen, and you had a saxophone player, his name was Roland Smith, and we had a singer, boy, he was from here. Louis Sims.
And by the way, a great woman trumpet player, her name was Valaida Snow (phomatic). She could sing, play the piano, play the violin, act, she was a genius. She was up there, in Denmark.
